title: Front Cover
content: Crawfish (Palinurus elephas) acoustically tagged within the Isles of Scilly, UK, rediscovered by recreational SCUBA divers 200m from the release location after release. The image related to Research Article “Are marine protected areas an effective tool to aid recovery of Palinurus elephas (European crawfish) in the North Atlantic?” [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70446]. Photo credit: Tim Allsop.
